name: Icosix Image Compressor
author: T Social

sections.description:
Icosix Image Compressor connects your WordPress site with the powerful Icosix image optimization service. Once a valid API key is provided, you can compress and optimize JPG, PNG, and WebP images directly from your WordPress dashboard while preserving full visual quality.

For users without an API key, manual compression is available via the
Image Compressor,
allowing you to quickly reduce image file sizes through an intuitive web interface.

Explore additional creative resources, graphics, icons, SVG vectors, and more on the
Icosix,
designed to support your design and development workflow beyond image optimization.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to the Settings > Icosix Compressor menu.
  4. Enter your API key.
